featured.metric: k6: 2,352 req/s at 50 VUs | 0% errors | p95 37 ms
featured.invariant: every event is persisted before the 202 returns, and a repeated idempotency key never creates a second row

more.name: Legal Document Classifier
more.desc: Classifies legal documents into five categories with a validation layer that checks confidence, class ambiguity, perturbation stability, and input quality. 88% of predictions pass all 5 invariant checks; 9% are flagged for review and 3% are held as low-confidence uncertain.

more.name: Go Ride Request Simulator
more.desc: State machine simulator of concurrent ride requests. Goroutine and channel implementations strictly order states when there are multiple concurrent accesses.

more.name: Security Risk Reporter
more.desc: Scoring engine for an 800-event data processing pipeline. Six pytest invariants: counts and sites preserved with no silent drops, per-type counts reconcile to totals, scores bounded [0,1], trend values valid, and intrusion-heavy sites outscore low-severity ones.

more.name: Distributed Systems Health Monitor
more.desc: Circuit breaker and fault injection across a six-service dependency graph. When the breaker is OPEN, zero calls are forwarded; every message is either delivered or explicitly rejected.

more.name: Pre-Trade Analytics Dashboard
more.desc: Black-Scholes pricing engine with an option chain grid and scenario analysis. Put-call parity holds to 1e-10 across every input combination tested, not only textbook examples.

more.name: Stat-Arb Signal Backtester
more.desc: Pairs-trading backtester that reruns an Engle-Granger cointegration test on every walk-forward window (train one year, trade one quarter) instead of screening once up front. 75 of 76 pair-windows failed the gate and produced zero trades; the stability report says so instead of averaging it away.
